text_block_list.text:
With the spring Tenno Sho on the
horizon and her
schedule as packed as
ever, Симболи Рудольф
attends to another
round of interviews.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the process, she announces the
academy's first
"Mega" Fan Fest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Following Эйр Грув's collapse, Symboli
Rudolf
has been working like a person
possessed to
reassure those around her
that she can still be
relied upon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her answer to her own perceived
shortcomings is
to work harder, run
faster, and show the world
that the
Emperor is flawless.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
